practice_check.title: The practice check
practice_check.reason: V5b failed on text-layer questions and V5c failed on OCR and VLM questions, so the check only warns; V4 failed on all three kinds, so practice questions are not described as easier than real ones
practice_check.wording: not reliably easier or harder than real questions

probe_allowance.title: Practice questions raising the layout one step
probe_allowance.reason: passed on text-layer (24 cases) and OCR (26 cases) questions and failed on VLM questions (15 cases, 20 needed); in-sample; left off: it has no effect while the practice check only warns

type_presets.title: Document-type presets
type_presets.reason: the DT campaign tested whether the standard rule's picks keep low >= target on each document type: it did for academic (32 of 32 units, 3 datasets, 4 models, worst margin +0.010) and did not for slides, reports or tables. It produced no type-specific numbers, so there is no preset that changes the rule; the academic result is reported as evidence only

evidence.academic: standard rule held on 32 of 32 units (v3_computer_science, v1_arxivqa; v1_syn_ai reported only)

small_memory_layout.title: The small-memory layout
small_memory_layout.reason: V9 ran at 20,000 pages on synthetic vectors (reports/easy/v9/): identical to the campaign's in-RAM two-tier path (64 of 64 queries, bitwise); private memory 318 MB (binary hot copy) and 140 MB (merged hot copy) within the bound of 522 MB and 342 MB; but the working set, which counts the memory-mapped 8-bit file's cached pages, was 1.71 GB and 1.52 GB, above the bound; and its top 10 matches plain 8-bit search on 15-30% of results (top 1: 100%). Left off until the 'resident' reading is decided

qdrant_export.title: Qdrant export
qdrant_export.reason: the gate test passed: top-10 equality 100% between Qdrant's MaxSim over the exported collection and the index's own exact search, on synthetic corpora in qdrant-client's local mode (float32 storage; the float16 option is outside the gate)

byaldi_import.title: byaldi import
byaldi_import.reason: the gate test passed: a byaldi 0.0.x index folder written by the test's own writer (it follows byaldi's source) comes back bit for bit, in byaldi's order, and a search over it ranks as MaxSim over byaldi's tensors; not run against the byaldi package

unmeasured_rules.title: Rules for models without rows of their own
unmeasured_rules.reason: codecs only, pooled minimum over measured models of the same modality (FINAL_DESIGN 5.1.4)

margins.title: Safety margins
margins.reason: as frozen in PREREG_EASY part 1; the 1-bit margin removed because arm B passed V1b and V1c with no severe 1-bit miss (176 units)
